name: hitsville-eq-warm-drum-glue
description: WARM, tight drum-bus tone from the UADx Hitsville EQ — the house warm+tight variant of the Motown move, with the present/airy top pulled back so it never reads brittle. Move: 50 +3 (kick weight), 130 +1 (body), 320 -2 (de-box the low-mids), 2000/5000 left FLAT (no presence push — avoids the 5-7 kHz brittleness), 12500 +1 (just a hint of cymbal air), GAIN -1. Warmth here = a low-tilt + de-boxed mids on a clean EQ (the Hitsville adds NO saturation — 0.000% THD), so for transformer-style warmth pair it with a tape/console stage (Studer/Ampex/Neve). Measured dry->processed on the watercolors drum bus: low ratio up, low-mid de-boxed, centroid barely moved (warm, not bright), crest preserved.
intended_for: a stereo drum bus you want warm + tight + glued without extra top — the house warm preference. Stack a tape/console saturation stage ([[studer-a800]]/[[ampex-atr-102]]/[[kit-bb-n105]]) for harmonic warmth; the Hitsville supplies the clean tonal shape.
plugin_build: UADx 'uaudio_hitsville_eq.vst3' (UADx native — RENDERS headless via Pedalboard, no-iLok). NOT the 'UAD Hitsville EQ.component' twin (passthrough offline).

target_signature.comment: measured dry->processed on projects/watercolors/mix/bus_warm_pre_dry.wav via the harness (peak-trim -1 dBFS). Dry: crest 23.6, centroid 3128, tilt -2.26, low 0.542, low_mid 0.378, high 0.0115.

notes: The Hitsville EQ has NO saturation/colour of its own (0.000% THD measured) — 'warm' is purely the tonal tilt (low weight + de-boxed mids + restrained top). For harmonic warmth, add a tape/console stage; this preset is the EQ shape only.

Top kept restrained on purpose: 2000 & 5000 flat, 12500 only +1. Bump 5000 +2 / 12500 +2 for the forward Motown variant (see hitsville-eq-motown-drum-bus.json), but watch 5-7 kHz brittleness on hat/cymbals.
GAIN is a clean linear trim; here -1 compensates the modest boosts. Never use a GAIN BOOST to make it louder on hot material — it clips past 0 dBFS (the only distortion this plugin produces).
